_experiment.description: [seed 1] Block A. Neuron pruning of the width-200 net to exhaustion (400 hidden neurons) with Omega = 10 000 TRAINING images (test split held out). Shared dense net for three selectors: manifold (neuron_sparsifier), magnitude (neuron_magnitude_sparsifier), OBD (neuron_obd_sparsifier, seeds 0-2). Analysis: scripts/analyze_crossbar.py (accuracy vs crossbar count).
